Strategy: Spread decides tight or loose. When residuals spread out, fill tightly with Best Fit; when they cluster together, spend the loosest bin and keep the tightest for exact fits, since the choice barely changes the leftover. Score Best Fit when the residual range exceeds the item, else by residual, so ranking can switch from Best Fit whenever bins cluster. It may help by protecting tight bins cheaply, but may fail by wasting loose bins when clusters hide real differences.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    spread = max(bins) - min(bins) > item
    return [-(r - item) if spread else r for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Spread-conditional: Best Fit when residual range > item, else worst-fit.
